description: How the aidrian plugin is built, checked, versioned, and changed: its agents, skills, hooks, commands, and project-folder contract.

working-agreement.md.summary: Rules every change here keeps: worktrees, generated agents, tests, hooks failing open, docs, the version left to the release, the knowledge index.

contributing.md.summary: Building and checking the plugin: npm run build and check, what the tests hold, trying a branch, skill evals, releases and versions.

agent-sources.md.summary: Editing the plugin's agents: group folders, neutral fields, provider files, addon merge order, adding a provider.

agents-and-skills.md.summary: The catalog of every agent and skill the plugin ships, grouped; tests hold it in sync with agents-src folders.

hooks.md.summary: Hooks, Bash rules: pr-body, main-checkout start lines, commit guard (pre-commit), commit messages, review gate, rounds, merge guard, kill, amend, terms, gates.
